$comment: Benchmark model tiers. Models are never committed to Git; they are pulled/downloaded at benchmark time. Tiers exist so results are comparable within a tier.

smoke.description: Tiny model for installation and functionality checks.

standard.description: Roughly 1B-4B quantized model; the default comparison tier.

performance.description: Roughly 7B-14B where hardware permits (>=12 GB VRAM recommended).

high-memory.description: Large models for workstations/high-memory platforms (>=24 GB VRAM or unified memory).

default_workload.prompt: Explain what a token is in large language models, in two sentences.
